Schema checked in CI (`--check`): status ∈ proposed | accepted | active | closed | abandoned; nextAction = ONE imperative action ≤ 300 chars, never what was just done; blockers ≤ 4 × 200 chars; openPoints ≤ 6 × 200 chars, no ✅ entry (what is done leaves this file); whole file ≤ 8 KB. Replace fields, never append a report to them. Public repository: nothing private here (client projects, private plugins). Detail: adr skill.
